scope.rule: Explicit nonempty operation allowlist, snapshotted by the mutation coordinator for delegated and application profiles

discovery.help:
mg-axi entra user list
List users with basic properties (id, displayName, userPrincipalName, mail)
--api-version <v1.0|beta>: Explicit API version; no fallback (default: v1.0)
--limit <positive-integer>: Cap returned rows; the remainder is buffered into an opaque cursor, never discarded; incompatible with --all (default: 100)
--all: Follow pages within request, byte and deadline budgets
--filter <odata-filter>: OData $filter passed to Graph; unsupported combinations fail before credentials
--select <comma-separated-properties>: Request server properties; richer properties need User.Read.All, accountEnabled needs User.EnableDisableAccount.All
--fields <comma-separated-properties>: Project returned rows locally; every field must be fetched via the default or --select set
--full: Show complete text values without truncation; never lifts redaction or row caps
--cursor <opaque-cursor>: Resume a capped collection losslessly; repeat the original query flags or omit them
--help: Show this reference
mg-axi entra user list

headlessInventory.activation: Wired into the production runtime registry. Live Graph authentication, application permissions, consent and deployment remain unverified; enabling Graph on a running installation requires live results and maintainer approval.
